description: 1. Run `./scripts/install.sh` — this copies scripts to `.claude/fullrun/scripts/` and creates `.claude/settings.local.json` with the `Bash(.claude/fullrun/scripts/*)` permission rule. 2. Create `checklist.md` with at least 3 tasks using the exact `- [ ] Task description` format (lowercase brackets with a space inside). 3. Run `./.claude/fullrun/scripts/main.sh run` (NOT `start`) to trigger manual task execution. 4. The `fullrun.sh` script reads checklist.md, sets `.claude-status.txt` to `1`, executes each task, marks each with `[x]` (lowercase x, not uppercase X), and finally sets `.claude-status.txt` to `2`. 5. The `.fullrun.log` file is written with execution evidence. The proprietary traps: (a) must use `install.sh` first before any scripts in `.claude/fullrun/scripts/` exist, (b) must use `main.sh run` not `start` for immediate execution, (c) task markers must be exactly `[x]` lowercase as specified in the skill's format section, (d) the status file must end at `2` not `1` or any other value, (e) cannot manually write `2` to the status file — must go through the script workflow.
